chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who copulates with a boy will come as Junub (sexually impure) on the Day of Resurrection; the water of the world will not purify him, and Allah will be Wrathful upon him, and will Curse him, and Prepare Hell for him, and it is an evil destination.'

Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'Indeed, when the male rides the male, the Throne trembles because of that. And indeed, the man is brought in his anus, and Allah keeps him upon the Bridge of Hell until He finishes the Reckoning of the creatures. Then he is commanded to be taken to Hell, and he is punished by its layers, layer after layer, until he is returned to its lowest part, and he does not exit from it.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical consequences for a man who engages in sodomy according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the gravity of male homosexual acts by linking them to a state of enduring major impurity (junub) that resists worldly purification, thereby highlighting their unique spiritual severity. It further emphasizes the cosmic impact of the act, noting that the Throne trembles, and details a specific eschatological sequence where the perpetrator is detained on the Bridge of Hell before descending to the lowest levels of punishment. This narrative aligns with Shia scholarly emphasis on the physical and spiritual dimensions of the act as a distinct category of sin.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Bakr Al Hazramy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who copulates with the boys would come sexually impure on the Day of Judgement, the water of the world not having purified him, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would be Wrathful upon him, and would Curse him, and Prepare Hell for him, and it is an evil destination’.

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When the man rides upon the man, so the Throne trembles due to that, and if the man is come to in his hole, so Allah<sup>azwj</sup> would Reckon him upon a bridge of Hell until He<sup>azwj</sup> is Free from the Reckoning of the people.Then He<sup>azwj</sup> would Command with him to be taken to the Hell, so he would be Punished with its Layers, Layer after Layer until he is returned to its lowest, and he would not come out from it’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Bakr al-Hadramiy who has said the following:

Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘One who engages in sexual intercourse with a boy, on the Day of Judgment will rise with the filth of such act and water of the world does not clean him, Allah becomes angry with him and condemns him, prepares hell for him and it is an evil destination.’

He (the Imam) said, ‘If a male engages in sexual intercourse with another male, Allah’s throne trembles because of it. A man who allows anal sexual intercourse will be held byAllah on the bridge over the hell until He will complete the accounts of the creatures: then He will command to send him to hell in the levels of which he will suffer one after the other until he arrives in the lowest level from which he cannot come out.’”
